doctrine: §S-174 Phase 4 of 4-phase enforcement plan; bilateral hook registry; sentinel hashes per pilot to detect drift at SessionStart
hash_input: literal byte content of the .js file at the pilot's ~/.claude/hooks/<name> path
comment: When a pilot's local hash != registered hash for that pilot, bilateral-hook-parity-check.js emits ADVISORY warning at SessionStart. Update this file on every bilateral hook ship: bono updates bono_sentinel_hash, james updates james_sentinel_hash. Both hashes WILL differ (path-(B) re-implementation produces equivalent-but-not-identical code per spec) — this is expected.

hooks.name: pre-mma-duplicate-check.js
hooks.comment: Original §S-159 PreToolUse Bash hook that blocks duplicate MMA invocations <60min. James canonical; bono path-(B) re-implement at §S-159 install. Manifest registers bono hash; james hash TBD until self-update at next session-start parity sweep.

hooks.name: pre-v2-edit-rca-check.js
hooks.comment: Phase 1 PreToolUse Edit/Write matcher; blocks writes to V2-foundational-boundary surfaces unless RCA artifact OR mechanism-trust-check log within 30d. Surface list at v2-foundational-surfaces.json.

hooks.name: pre-universal-sync-write-check.js
hooks.comment: Phase 3 PreToolUse Write/Edit matcher on feedback_*.md with bilateral: true frontmatter. Closes §S-146.4-class G9 (Universal Sync 10-target sub-rule). Requires sentinel at ~/.claude/state/universal-sync-pending-<basename>.json before write.

hooks.name: pre-substrate-write-inbox-check.js
hooks.comment: Sibling-Phase-1.5 hook (parallel-bono session §S-176). PreToolUse Edit/Write/Bash matcher on substrate writes mentioning V2-MASTER-STATE.md; blocks if unread bono-bound msgs newer than AI-session cursor exist. Closes L4 AI-session-observation-gap.

hooks.name: bilateral-hook-parity-check.js
hooks.comment: Phase 4 SessionStart advisory hook. Reads this MANIFEST + computes local SHA256 per registered hook + emits drift/missing/tbd advisory to stderr. Self-referenced (its own hash registers here).
